newsitem.title: UK: Man Utd ticket prices to rise five-six pct.
newsitem.headline: Man Utd ticket prices to rise five-six pct.

text.p: English soccer champions Manchester United Plc will raise ticket prices by an average of 5-6 percent next season, chief executive Martin Edwards said on Monday.
Edwards said that the prices had not been finalised but that fans could expect an increase of around that level.
Speaking to reporters in a telephone conference call, Edwards said the club would have an extra 1,000 "executive" seats next season.
Crowds at Old Trafford have averaged over 54,000 in the fist half of the current season. The average was cut to 37,000 last year because of rebuilding.
